maria-ops: Quick note 1: planning an overnight unpin from runtime-2.14 -> 2.15 in eu-west. Window 00:30-03:00 UTC. Motivation: kernel tail fixes + batching perf. Small blocker: mobile sdk@2.3 has a client signature mismatch we need to shim.

deploybot: [automated] scheduled: unpin runtime-2.14 for cohort 'batch-eu'. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50%. Abort triggers: error_rate>1.3% OR p95_latency_up>30% OR failed_regressions>2.

leo-platform: Telemetry baseline shows median token latency -3ms but p95 can spike under burst tests. Recommend server-only canary for 30m first. Also watch kvcache miss delta.

maria-ops: Rollout plan:
- 00:30 UTC eu-west server-only canary 1% (X-Client-Type=server) for 30m
- 01:00 bump to 10% excluding mobile for 20m
- 01:20 50% if stable then evaluate for full rollout
Rollback snippet for runbook:
```
# emergency rollback
deployctl revert --runtime runtime-2.14 --selector "cohort=batch-eu" --reason "canary-failure"
# partial rollback:
deployctl revert --percent 10 --selector "cohort=batch-eu"
```

devex: I'll update release notes and SDK compat table. Including shim steps: add header X-Client-Compat: shim-v0.8 for mobile clients, and migration note for sdk@2.4.

nora-qa: Kicking off targeted regressions at canary start (kv integrity, repeated-token, streaming). Will post results to #eng-qa. Any regression -> immediate rollback signal.

deploybot: [automated] canary started: eu-west cohort 'batch-eu' 1% server-only. Monitoring probes active.
